newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds untraded on New York, London hols.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds untraded on New York, London hols.

text.p: Local Argentine bonds were untraded Monday as players stayed away due to the closure of New York and London.
"Zero - there is nothing going on today," said a trader.
No trades were recorded on screens in locally-traded bonds.
On Friday, the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 due 2001 rose $0.14 to 122.97.
There was some sporadic activity in Brady bonds, however, with Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 down 1/8 at 92-7/8.
